text:
xpcshell:
    description: "xpcshell test run"
    suite:
        category: xpcshell
        name: xpcshell
    target:
        by-test-platform:
            windows11-64.*:
                by-variant:
                    msix: target.installer.msix
                    default: null
            default: null
    treeherder-symbol: X(X)
    variants:
        - msix
    run-on-projects:
        by-variant:
            msix:
                by-test-platform:
                    # Disabled: the xpcshell selftest hangs under MSIX. Firefox
                    # no longer runs xpcshell on MSIX either.
                    windows11-64.*: []
                    default: []
            default: built-projects
    tier:
        by-test-platform:
            .*-asan.*: 2
            .*-ccov.*: 2
            .*-tsan.*: 2
            macosx1100.*: 2
            windows11.*: 1
            default: default
    chunks:
        by-test-platform:
            .*-ccov.*/.*: 10
            .*-tsan.*/opt: 10
            default: 5
    timeoutfactor:
        by-test-platform:
            linux.*64-asan-qr/opt: 2
            linux1804-64-ccov-qr/opt: 4
            linux.*64-ccov/opt: 4
            linux.*64-tsan-qr/opt: 3
            linux.*64/debug: 2
            macosx1015-64.*: 6
            macosx1470-64/debug: 6
            macosx1470-64.*/opt: 4
            windows.*/debug: 2
            windows11-64-25h2-asan/opt: 2
            windows11-64-25h2-ccov/opt: 3
            default: 1
    instance-size: default
    max-run-time:
        by-variant:
            msix: 7200
            default:
                by-test-platform:
                    .*-ccov(-qr)?/.*: 7200
                    .*-tsan.*/opt: 7200
                    windows.*/opt: 5400
                    default: 2700
    allow-software-gl-layers: false
    mozharness:
        script: desktop_unittest.py
        config:
            by-test-platform:
                windows.*:
                    - unittests/win_unittest.py
                    - unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
                macosx.*64.*:
                    - unittests/mac_unittest.py
                    - unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
                linux.*:
                    - unittests/linux_unittest.py
                    - remove_executables.py
                    - unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
